column1: # p153 — ACTION GC. The 17 theses the p151 register marked NO_DEFINITION, resolved.
# Scope: the same 10 content files p151 used. Nothing outside it was read, so GC's
# falsifier — "refuted if any of the 17 is defined on a page this pass's scope missed" —
# is NOT tested by this file and is NOT claimed to be silent.
# WHAT THE MEASUREMENT CHANGES: the premise "no definition anywhere" is WRONG for 6 of
# the 17. Their statement IS on an in-scope, non-append-only page — but only ever in
# REVISIT shape (HELD / GENERALISED / STRENGTHENED / VINDICATED), never as an
# introduction. The register's grammar reads a revisit as not-a-definition, correctly;
# the DEBT it reports is therefore a first-mention debt, not a meaning debt.
# cited = occurrences of the backticked id over the 10 files INCLUDING README.md and
# intel/open-gaps.md. p151's register used a different denominator, so these counts are
# HIGHER and are not a correction of p151's: two instruments, two denominators.
